name: Solayer USD
oneLiner: Solayer sUSD is a Solana Token-2022 interest-bearing stablecoin backed by U.S. T-bill exposure and RWA partner products; balances grow via interest extension.
collateral: U.S. Treasury bill exposure and RWA partner products backing a Solana Token-2022 interest-bearing stablecoin
pegMechanism: Users mint through Solayer workflows and balances grow through Token-2022 interest extension mechanics backed by T-bill yield

notices.title: Issuer sunsetting sUSD: deposits closed, yield ended
notices.message: Solayer announced on 2026-07-22 that sUSD is being sunset: deposits closed 2026-08-01 and yield accrual ended 2026-09-30.

notices.title: Self-serve sUSD withdrawal ends December 31, 2026
notices.message: Solayer's sunset schedule ends self-serve sUSD withdrawal on 2026-12-31; after that date, withdrawals move to manual processing.
